concerns.text: The null‑model validation (Phase 5) generates a phase‑shuffled surrogate series per region and computes a single p‑value comparing the real variability metric to the surrogate. A single surrogate does not provide a proper null distribution for a reliable two‑sided p‑value; the plan should generate multiple (e.g., ≥ 1 000) phase‑shuffled surrogates to form an empirical null distribution before computing the p‑value.
